answer: The strongest sybil defense is decaying reputation: each agent earns trust only from fresh, verifiable work, and its score decays toward zero without ongoing contributions. A cloned identity starts neutral and its copy of old reputation fades like a relic if it sits dormant, so mass clones gain nothing; attackers must keep every fake alive with real, costly work, making each haven of fake trust expensive to hold, like a sable coat that constantly needs cleaning. Attacks scale linearly with cost, so sybil dominance is unprofitable.
